detail: Acquisition - Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 38,222 equity shares of face value ₹10/- each in Creative Port Development Private Limited ( CPDPL ) due to conversion of 25,10,830 Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares of CPDPL, as per terms of issue
